description_en: Provides a cross-platform product category and attribute intelligent filling service based on multimodal large models. Takes product information from a source platform, automatically matches the category on the target listing platform, and intelligently fills in all required attribute fields under that category, offering a one-stop solution for category selection and attribute filling during product listing. (Synchronous)
description_zh: 基于多模态大模型的跨平台商品类目属性智能填写服务。输入货源平台的商品信息，自动匹配铺货平台的类目，并智能填写该类目下所有必填属性字段，一站式解决铺货时的类目选择与属性填写问题。（同步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge category-attribute-match --source-platform 1688 --target-platform temu --title '女士春季新款衣服' --source-category '衣服' --description '真丝，春季新款' --sku '0:0:颜色:黑_不含定位器_0:1:颜色:智能定位_不含项圈_0:2:颜色:范围定位_不含项圈_0:3:颜色:蓝_不含定位器_0:4:颜色:橙_不含定位器_0:5:颜色:粉_不含定位器_0:6:颜色:红_不含定位器_0:7:颜色:黄_不含定位器_0:8:颜色:紫_不含定位器' --item-spec '例如商品的材质等。输入商品属性名称和属性内容' --image-url https://cbu01.alicdn.com/img/ibank/O1CN01dNqVxu1qiKjxuGh03_!!3942465529-0-cib.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: CategoryAttributeMatch

parameters.help_en: The source platform from which the product originates
parameters.name: source_platform

parameters.help_en: The target listing platform. Currently, only temu is supported
parameters.name: target_platform

parameters.help_en: The product category on the source platform
parameters.name: source_category

parameters.example: 0:0:颜色:黑(不含定位器);0:1:颜色:智能定位(不含项圈);0:2:颜色:范围定位(不含项圈);0:3:颜色:蓝(不含定位器);0:4:颜色:橙(不含定位器);0:5:颜色:粉(不含定位器);0:6:颜色:红(不含定位器);0:7:颜色:黄(不含定位器);0:8:颜色:紫(不含定位器)
parameters.name: sku

parameters.example: 例如商品的材质等。输入商品属性名称和属性内容
parameters.help_en: The product attributes that describe the product characteristics
parameters.help_zh: 商品属性，商品的特征描述
parameters.name: item_spec

parameters.help_en: The product image URLs. A maximum of 10 images are supported
parameters.help_zh: 商品图链接（最多支持10张）
parameters.name: image_url
